visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short bob hair, wearing a grey oversized blazer over a white shirt, stands in an indoor office environment next to a large white banner featuring the Google logo. She smiles warmly at the camera, gesturing with her hands to welcome viewers to the scene. (2) The scene cuts to her pointing directly at the camera with an excited expression, then she pulls both fists close to her chest in a cheering motion. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her expressive facial features and the professional indoor setting. (3) She transitions to standing in front of a light wood display shelf where four different colored Google Pixel 9a smartphones are mounted on stands. She points towards the devices, which are arranged neatly in a row against a light background. (4) Close-up shots showcase the phones in detail: a white ceramic-like finish, a lavender-purple, a vibrant pink, and a sleek matte black. The camera pans across the shelf, emphasizing the smooth textures and modern design of the hardware components and camera lenses. (5) The woman holds the pink model close to her cheek, smiling brightly while the background reveals a sweeping urban cityscape through large floor-to-ceiling windows, suggesting a high-rise location. She then gestures toward the phone's back and sides to show its metallic frame. (6) In the final phase, she holds two phones, one white and one black, in front of her. She waves to the camera with a cheerful grin as the video ends, maintaining high energy and a friendly posture throughout the professional product showcase.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們現在在. [Logo]: @HanHan. (2) [Subtitle]: Google Pixel 的新品拍攝活動. (3) [Subtitle]: Google Pixel 出新品囉. (4) [Subtitle]: 這一次一共有四個顏色. (5) [Subtitle]: Pixel 9a 分別是 陶瓷米, 鳶尾紫, 莓果粉 和 曜石黑. (6) [Subtitle]: 莓果粉真的超級美的吧. (7) [Subtitle]: 背面跟 Pixel 9 一樣 手感光滑. (8) [Subtitle]: 除了有金屬邊框, 防水功能也有升級. (9) [Subtitle]: 進階 IP68 抗水防塵保護等級. [Subtitle]: 能防塵、防摔、防潑濺. (10) [Subtitle]: 主鏡頭 4,800 萬像素. [Subtitle]: 超廣角鏡頭是 1,300 萬像素. (11) [Subtitle]: 也跟 Pixel 9 一樣有「一起拍」功能. [Subtitle]: 可以讓攝影師合成進團體照. (12) [Subtitle]: Gemini 跟 AI 修圖功能也一樣沒有少. (13) [Subtitle]: 至於價格 官方還沒公佈. (14) [Subtitle]: 其他功能就等我們未來實測吧.
